idea: Build a fitness & workout planner app
tagline: Adaptive workout planning and real-time auto-regulation for peak strength gains.
targetAudience: Fitness enthusiasts, intermediate lifters, bodybuilders, and gym beginners looking for dynamic progressive overload, automated workout adjustments, and friction-free set logging without the cost of personal trainers.

mvpFeatures.name: Single-Tap Active Workout Tracker
mvpFeatures.description: Ultra-minimalist live gym interface designed for rapid set logging, automatic rest timer triggers, and zero UI clutter between sets.

mvpFeatures.name: Dynamic Auto-Regulation Engine
mvpFeatures.description: Calculates targeted weight and rep recommendations for subsequent sets based on logged RPE (Rating of Perceived Exertion) and historical performance.

mvpFeatures.name: Hybrid Equipment Routine Builder
mvpFeatures.description: Routine creator that dynamically adjusts exercise selections based on current location and available equipment (e.g., commercial gym vs. home bodyweight/dumbbells).

mvpFeatures.name: Target Muscle Heatmap
mvpFeatures.description: Visual 2D/3D body diagram displaying target muscle strain, volume distribution, and recovery status across weekly workouts.

mvpFeatures.name: Progressive Overload Analytics
mvpFeatures.description: Comprehensive charts tracking estimated 1RM (One Rep Max), total volume, set consistency, and personal records per exercise.

futureFeatures.name: Wearable Recovery Integration
futureFeatures.description: Syncs with Apple Health, Whoop, and Oura to dynamically scale daily workout volume based on Sleep and HRV metrics.

futureFeatures.name: Voice & Wrist-Based Logging
futureFeatures.description: Frictionless hands-free set logging via smartwatch app and natural language voice commands.

futureFeatures.name: Interactive 3D Muscle Visualizer
futureFeatures.description: Post-set real-time 3D anatomical model showing real-time biomechanical fatigue and muscle engagement.

futureFeatures.name: AI Computer Vision Form Check
futureFeatures.description: Camera-based real-time form feedback and bar-path tracking for heavy compound lifts.

userPersonas.name: Marcus - Dedicated Intermediate Lifter
painPoints: Frustrated by complex, bloated workout apps that slow down logging between intense sets
Struggles to manually calculate progressive overload and dynamic RPE targets on the fly
goals: Consistently hit progressive overload targets without manual math
Log workouts in under 5 seconds per set during live gym sessions

userPersonas.name: Elena - Hybrid Gym Goer
painPoints: Static workout programs break down when equipment at the gym is occupied or when working out at home
Overwhelmed by static workout templates that don't adjust when fatigue is high
goals: Seamlessly swap exercises based on available home or gym equipment
Maintain long-term routine consistency with personalized guidance

userJourneys.description: User opens the app at the gym, starts a scheduled session, logs sets rapidly, and receives real-time weight adjustments.
steps: Selects scheduled workout or equipment profile (e.g., Commercial Gym)
Taps into the active workout logging screen with pre-filled target weight/reps based on previous performance
Completes set and taps single-button complete, entering actual weight, reps, and optional RPE score
Rest timer automatically starts while AI engine recalculates target weight/reps for the next set if fatigue is indicated
Finishes session and views immediate summary card featuring muscle volume heatmap and PR achievements

userJourneys.description: User sets up a personalized split tailored to their equipment access and weekly schedule.
steps: Navigates to Routine Builder and chooses split type (e.g., Push/Pull/Legs)
Selects available equipment tags (e.g., Barbell, Cables, Dumbbells)
App generates progressive program with automatic substitute exercise suggestions for busy equipment

screens.name: Active Workout Logger
screens.purpose: Minimalist, high-contrast interface for live set tracking, timer management, and instant load adjustment
keyComponents: Exercise Header with Quick Swap Trigger
Current Set Card (Weight, Reps, RPE Input)
Rest Timer Banner with Auto-Play Notifications

screens.name: Today & Readiness Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of today's planned session, muscle recovery status, and weekly streak

screens.name: Routine & Equipment Configurator
screens.purpose: Allows users to create, customize, and filter routines by available training equipment

screens.name: Progress & Analytics
screens.purpose: In-depth visual feedback on overall strength progression, 1RM estimates, and muscle balance

routes.name: Dashboard
routes.description: Overview of daily training readiness and quick session access

routes.name: Routines
routes.description: Manage and create dynamic workout programs

routes.name: Analytics
routes.description: Detailed progress and volume tracking charts

techStack.frontend: React Native / Expo (TypeScript) with NativeWind & Reanimated
techStack.backend: Node.js / Express (TypeScript) with Python FastAPI for ML recommendation engine
techStack.database: PostgreSQL / Prisma ORM with Redis for live workout state caching

monetizationModel: Freemium model offering free core set logging and basic routines; Pro subscription ($9.99/month or $59.99/year) unlocks AI auto-regulation load recommendations, wearable recovery integration, and advanced muscle analytics.
